purpose: Test whether feature-level fusion of the E65 correlation-logSPD view (structured, 855-d) and the E162 raw-EEG end-to-end contrastive embedding (256-d, effective rank 8) raises the open-set diagnostic AUC above the E143 0.7578 baseline. E153 showed that a second score from the E143 view itself (E152 trial-centred invariant) was redundant; E162 is a genuinely different information source, so complementarity is re-tested under the verbatim E143 protocol.

E65_logspd.note: 855-d correlation log-SPD vector, the E143 representation

E162_raw_eeg.note: 256-d embedding of the best E162 config (lambda=0.0, t=0.1); task-standardised effective rank 95% = 8, so dims beyond 32 are deliberately included only to show the plateau

standardisation.rule: per stream, task-wise z-score with Train-session1 statistics only (all Train rows of that task), identical to E143/E162 so the controls reproduce exactly
standardisation.sensitivity: the E65 control is re-run with fit-rows-only statistics (frac <= 0.6) to show the conclusion does not depend on which Train rows supply the mean/std

variants.raw: concat(E65 PCA, E162 PCA) then joint PCA
variants.block_norm: each PCA block divided by its fit-row RMS std so both contribute equal total variance, then joint PCA

score_fusion.selection_metric: Train LOSO AUC (pooled held-identity unknown proxy vs enrolled known block) of the fused z-score; Test is never consulted
score_fusion.z_normalisation: each stream score z-scored with its own 5-block Train OOF mean/std before weighting

E162_raw_eeg_contrastive_v2.config: raw EEG embedding, PCA-64, k=1, acceptance 0.88

E159_ceiling.note: single-score threshold tuning ceiling on E143 is W = 0.7352, so the diagnostic AUC has to move

protocol.prototypes: k-means (E143 seeding, 20 iters) per (task, identity) on fit_rows only
protocol.train_oof: 5 contiguous frac blocks, prototypes rebuilt without the held block
protocol.threshold: quantile of the 5-block Train OOF score at each acceptance rate; LOSO uses the per-fold known-block quantile
protocol.test: scored only; session used only for the post-hoc diagnostic AUC

reporting.test_official: N/A: the Test split has no public labels; session labels are used only for the diagnostic AUC after scoring
reporting.headline_working_point: W at the reference acceptance 0.90 (E143 working point) plus the acceptance-grid selected best W, clearly separated because the latter uses Test
